svg.title: EFZ — guardian и controlled descendant lifecycle
svg.desc: Guardian владеет процессами и coverage независимо от coordinator. Final result возвращается после DOWN, trace barriers и проверки dirty runner.

text.tspan: Late uncontrolled spawn adds a monitor and barrier, marks run dirty

svg.text: Check pinned harness and selected builds
Create protected PID registry, enable context/code traces
Register root expected context before gate
gated spawn, monitor, trace, record ownership
First published probes / sticky hook failures
Recheck code identities, attachment and sticky failures
snapshot, validate probes and saved observations, close
